title: Setup & status

adminSmtp.title: E-mail sending is not set up
adminSmtp.consequence: Without a mail server TravStats cannot send invitations, password resets or reminders by e-mail.

adminPublicUrl.title: Check the public address
adminPublicUrl.consequence: Without a valid address that is reachable from outside, links in mails, pairing QR codes and sharing lead nowhere.

adminBackup.title: Automatic backup
adminBackup.consequence: Without a recent backup a disk failure loses everything stored on this server.

adminDisk.title: Disk space
adminDisk.consequence: When the disk is full, backups, uploads and the database itself fail.

adminOffsite.title: Copy off site
adminOffsite.consequence: A backup on the same machine does not survive losing that machine.

adminProviderKeys.title: Data service keys
adminProviderKeys.consequence: Without a valid key, flight search and live data return nothing, and nobody notices.

adminBookingMailbox.title: Booking mailbox
adminBookingMailbox.consequence: When the mailbox is unreachable, forwarded bookings never arrive.

userDomains.title: Choose your travel types
userDomains.consequence: Without chosen travel types TravStats shows only empty pages.

userHome.title: Set your home
userHome.consequence: Without a home TravTrack knows neither the way home nor departure places, and recognises stays less well.

userPhonePaired.title: Pair a phone
userPhonePaired.consequence: Without a paired phone the Companion app records and syncs nothing.

userFirstPosition.title: Receive the first position
userFirstPosition.consequence: The phone is paired, but no position has arrived yet.

userApiKeys.title: Check your own keys
userApiKeys.consequence: An expired key of your own makes lookups fail without a word.

userMailForwarding.title: Set up the forwarding address
userMailForwarding.consequence: Without forwarding and an allowed sender, no booking mail reaches you.

userNotificationEmail.title: E-mail for reminders
userNotificationEmail.consequence: Reminders by e-mail need an address to go to.

adminRailRouter.title: Rail journeys drawn as straight lines
adminRailRouter.title_one: {{count}} rail journey as a straight line
adminRailRouter.consequence: Without a rail router the map draws every journey as a straight line across the country, and the distances are off.

adminRoadRouting.title: Road legs drawn as straight lines
adminRoadRouting.consequence: No routing service is active for roadtrips, tours, ferries and coaches, so distances and driving times are only estimates.

adminRoutingKeyUnused.title: Road routing is off although a key is stored
adminRoutingKeyUnused.consequence: A key for OpenRouteService or GraphHopper is stored, but no routing provider is selected, so every leg stays a straight line.

adminTwoFactor.title: Admin account without a second factor
adminTwoFactor.consequence: Whoever guesses your password runs the whole server. A second factor or a passkey stops that.

adminDemoAccount.title: Demo account is active
adminDemoAccount.consequence: Anyone with the public demo credentials can sign in to this server.

userRailStraight.title: Rail journeys drawn as straight lines
userRailStraight.title_one: {{count}} rail journey as a straight line
userRailStraight.consequence: Your map shows them as straight lines and their distances are estimates. The admin sets up the rail router.

userRoadStraight.title: Legs drawn as straight lines
userRoadStraight.consequence: Roadtrips, tours and coach rides without a routing service show straight lines and estimated driving times.

userTravtrackSilent.title: No position from the phone for over a day
userTravtrackSilent.consequence: TravTrack is recording but nothing arrives. The Companion app may have been closed, location access denied, or the phone unpaired.

userVisitScanBacklog.title: Place search disrupted
userVisitScanBacklog.consequence: The stops of these days have not been searched for visited places yet, usually because the place service does not answer. Suggestions are missing until then.

userFlightsNoTimes.title: Flights without a time
userFlightsNoTimes.consequence: Without a departure time the duration, the order and the day in your statistics are missing.
userFlightsNoTimes.action: Add the time from the boarding pass or booking

userFlightsNoArrival.title: Flights without an arrival time
userFlightsNoArrival.consequence: Without an arrival the flight time can only be estimated.
userFlightsNoArrival.action: Add the arrival from the boarding pass or booking

userFlightsLegacyTime.title: Flights with an old import time
userFlightsLegacyTime.title_one: {{count}} flight with an old import time
userFlightsLegacyTime.title_other: {{count}} flights with an old import time
userFlightsLegacyTime.consequence: An earlier import stored the time as a placeholder. It can be hours off.
userFlightsLegacyTime.action: Add the time from the boarding pass or booking

userFlightsMidnightPlaceholder.title: Flights at exactly midnight
userFlightsMidnightPlaceholder.consequence: 00:00 local time looks exact but is usually a placeholder for “time unknown”. Duration and day may be wrong.

userFlightsDateOnly.title: Flights with a date only
userFlightsDateOnly.consequence: The date is right, the time is missing. The flight time needs one.

userStaysNoCoords.title: Stays without a location
userStaysNoCoords.consequence: They are missing from the map and count in no country.

userDuplicateVisits.title: Duplicate visits
userDuplicateVisits.title_one: {{count}} place visited twice on the same day
userDuplicateVisits.title_other: {{count}} places visited twice on the same day
userDuplicateVisits.consequence: Two visits to the same place on the same day count twice in statistics and lists.

userTripCountryMismatch.title: Trip countries contradict the entries
userTripCountryMismatch.title_one: {{count}} trip with a wrong country list
userTripCountryMismatch.title_other: {{count}} trips with a wrong country list
userTripCountryMismatch.consequence: The stored country list leaves out a country one of the trip's entries is in. The list wins, so the country is missing.

userPackageDoublePriced.title: Package priced twice
userPackageDoublePriced.consequence: Two bookings on the same trip carry the same price or booking number, so the cost counts twice.

userZoneMismatch.title: Time zone does not match the place
userZoneMismatch.title_one: {{count}} entry with a wrong time zone
userZoneMismatch.title_other: {{count}} entries with a wrong time zone
userZoneMismatch.consequence: The stored time zone of a stay or visit does not belong to its place, so its times show shifted. An admin can re-resolve the zones under Maintenance › Time model.

v280SettingsRemoved.before: Some settings are gone: log size and count, the old country threshold and the OpenSky credentials.
v280SettingsRemoved.after: They are removed, TravStats keeps running on fixed values.

v280BackupsAlwaysOn.before: Automatic backups could be switched off.

v280RetentionScheduledOnly.before: Retention also deleted backups made by hand.
v280RetentionScheduledOnly.after: It now deletes only what the schedule created; everything else stays until you delete it.

v280FriendsMerged.before: Friends and connections to other servers were separate.
v280FriendsMerged.after: Each friend is now one connection on the Friends page.

v280ExternalServicesMoved.before: Services were configured through server environment variables.
v280ExternalServicesMoved.after: The values were copied into the settings on first start and are managed there.

v280OwnServersPublic.before: Your own Immich or Dawarich server could be reached on the home network.
v280OwnServersPublic.after: An ordinary account's connection must now point at a public address.
